name: Unlearning
description: Headphone music for unlearning: for anyone loosening the grip of a high-control belief system, a rigid upbringing or an old certainty, and finding their own voice again. A hymn that spreads from a point in your head into open space, slogans whispered from every side that fade one by one, an insistent voice and your own trading ears, a unison that drifts apart into two views, a march that fades while your own rhythm grows, questions left unresolved, a tune that exists only between your two ears, and rest over slow binaural drones before a first morning. Each sketch explains its trick in the comments. This is music, not therapy: if leaving has been hard, be gentle with yourself and lean on people you trust. Headphones on, volume low.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Loosening the Hymn
sketches.description: The hymn you were taught, four square chords on the organ, steps through the interaural phase: it starts in the centre of your head and spreads into a haze around you. From the fifth bar a line of your own enters and stays. On speakers the 180-degree bars of the organ nearly vanish.

sketches.name: Echo Chamber
sketches.description: Headphones on: the same few words are whispered from every side of your head at once, then each voice fades away in turn, until only a still pad in the middle and your own breathing remain. Listen through once from the start.

sketches.name: Two Voices
sketches.description: An old, insistent voice leans into one ear and your own voice into the other, through a level difference between the ears. Every fourth bar they trade places, so neither owns either ear, and over time the old voice grows quieter.
sketches.source:
setcpm(66/4)

// ild makes the right ear louder; earswap flips the ears on the bars marked 1
// The old voice leans into one ear, flat and insistent, and fades from bar 8 to bar 24
old: note("<[a2 a2 a2 a2] [a2 a2 g2 a2] [a2 a2 a2 a2] [g2 g2 a2 ~]>")
  .s("voice").voicetype("bass").syl("<[must must must must] [no no shud no] [must must must must] [shud shud no ~]>")
  .ild(8).earswap("<0 0 0 1>").mono(1).vglide(.04)
  .attack(.05).release(.3).room(.3).gain(.2).fadeout(16, 8)

// Your own voice leans into the other ear, and on the fourth bar they trade places
yours: note("<[e4@3 d4] [c#4@2 e4@2] [f#4@3 e4] [a4@4]>")
  .s("voice").voicetype("alto").syl("<[i@3 am] [hir@2 _@2] [i@3 am] [fri@4]>")
  .ild(8).earswap("<1 1 1 0>").mono(2).vglide(.1)
  .attack(.1).release(.8).room(.5).gain(.26)

// A centred drone and soft harp chords, the same in both ears: A, F#m, D, E
drone: note("[a1,e2]").slow(4).s("sine").attack(2).sustain(1).release(3).gain(.16)
harp: note("<[a3 c#4 e4 c#4] [f#3 a3 c#4 a3] [d3 f#3 a3 f#3] [e3 g#3 b3 g#3]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").decay(.5).sustain(0).release(.6).room(.5).gain(.16)

sketches.name: Cents of Doubt
sketches.description: One certainty, sounded in perfect unison, slowly drifts apart between the ears in cents and comes back again: at 3 cents it beats slowly, at 8 and 15 it shimmers, and at 30 it opens into a chorus of two views. A piano asks and answers in the centre.

sketches.name: Your Own Rhythm
sketches.description: The march you kept step to plays dead centre, square and loud, and fades away from the fourth bar, while your own rhythm grows from nothing: hand drums placed all around you and a kalimba swaying between your ears on delays under a millisecond.
sketches.source:
setcpm(96/4)

// The march you kept step to: centred, square and loud, fading out over bars 4 to 12
march: s("bd ~ bd ~, ~ sd ~ sd, hh*8").gain(.4).fadeout(8, 4)
drill: note("<c2 g1>").struct("x ~ x ~").s("sawtooth").lpf(600)
  .decay(.2).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.3).fadeout(8, 4)

// Your own rhythm grows from nothing: hand drums placed around you, seeded but free
hands: s("lt*8?0.45, rim*16?0.3").azimuth(rand.range(-150, 150)).distance(2)
  .seed("own-time").room(.3).gain(.3).fadein(12)

// Under about 0.7 ms a delay between the ears moves a sound sideways: the kalimba sways
kalimba: n(irand(6).segment(8)).scale("C:major pentatonic").transpose(12)
  .degradeBy(.4).seed("sway")
  .s("sine").fm(.8).fmh(5.4).decay(.8).sustain(0).release(.8)
  .itd(sine.range(-.6, .6).slow(4)).room(.4).gain(.2).fadein(8)

// A low pulse that never marches: one soft note per bar, centred
root: note("<c2 a1 f1 g1>").s("sine").attack(.3).sustain(.7).release(1).gain(.28)

sketches.name: Turning It Over
sketches.description: A drone's phase turns slowly between your ears, so it rolls around inside your head like an idea being turned over. Four bars of questions in the whole-tone scale, which has no home note, are followed by four bars of an answer in lydian that is allowed to stay open. All rates stay below 3 Hz.

sketches.name: A Voice Only You Can Hear
sketches.description: Each ear alone hears only a hiss of white noise; together they carry a faint tune between them (Huggins pitch), something nobody can hand you, only hear for yourself. A quiet sine plays the first phrase every four bars so you know what to listen for. The effect is faint and differs between listeners.

sketches.name: Wide Open
sketches.description: Headphones on: soft noise steps from identical in both ears, a narrow point in the middle of your head, to unrelated in each, wide and all around you, over a 2 Hz binaural drone in the delta range, below the rates that trigger a pulse warning. A bell marks each step outward.

sketches.name: Theta Integration
sketches.description: Headphones on: a 6 Hz binaural beat in the theta range under slow choir chords, while a pad sends alternate partials to each ear, so it sounds whole only when both ears hear it together, like pieces coming back into one. A stream runs nearby. The player asks before playing, as with any steady pulse.

sketches.name: First Morning
sketches.description: The first morning after: birds placed all around you, a lark gliding high overhead, a flute and harp straight ahead, a wide breeze through an open door and a quiet 10 Hz binaural beat in the alpha range for waking gently. The player asks before playing, as with any steady pulse.
sketches.source:
setcpm(80/4)

// The first morning: birds placed all around you, each in its own place
robin: s("bird").slow(2).azimuth(-40).distance(3).gain(.22)
wren: s("bird").slow(3).azimuth(60).elevation(25).distance(4).gain(.18)
lark: s("bird").slow(4).azimuth(saw.range(-90, 90).slow(16)).elevation(50).distance(8).posglide(.5).gain(.14)

// A 10 Hz binaural beat in the alpha range: keep it quiet
drone: note("<g2 g2 e2 c2>").slow(2).s("sine").binaural(10)
  .attack(3).sustain(1).release(4).gain(.12)

// A flute straight ahead, the same in both ears, and a harp: G, Em, C, D
flute: note("<[d5@2 b4 g4 b4@2 d5@2] [e5@3 d5 b4@4] [c5@2 e5 g5 e5@2 d5 c5] [d5@6 ~@2]>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(5).vibdepth(.1)
  .attack(.06).sustain(.6).release(.5).delay(.25).delaytime(3/8).room(.5).gain(.22)
harp: note("<[g3 b3 d4 b3] [e3 g3 b3 g3] [c4 e4 g4 e4] [d3 f#3 a3 f#3]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").decay(.4).sustain(0).release(.5).room(.5).gain(.18)

// The door is open: the breeze comes in wide, unrelated in each ear
breeze: s("pink").slow(8).icorr(.15).hpf(300).lpf(2000).gain(.025)
